name: FileTimeOfPath
notes: Seconds of a file by selector: 1 creation, 2 modification, 3 access, anything else 0; 0 when the stat fails. Converts the path text through RZText (stood in on both sides), then stats the ANSI text. The CRT stat in the image (0x83bab7) is patched to a host _stat64i32 wrapper on the original side, since the image CRT cannot run in the harness. Difftest over an existing file with three distinct times and a missing one, selectors -1..5. Mutants killed: selectors 1, 2, 3 swapped to another time.

name: PathDelete
notes: Deletes a file by path: through the wide function cell 0x10cb5f0 when filled, else DeleteFileA through the import slot 0xd9a1f0 on the ANSI text; true when the call reported success. Both cells are fakes logging the text, on both sides. Mutants killed: result inverted, result forced true.

name: GetTempDirectory
notes: The system temp directory into a string: wide GetTempPathW + GetLongPathNameW from the cells at 0x10cb5e0 when both are filled, else GetTempPathA (slot 0xd9a21c) and GetLongPathNameA when filled; false (text untouched) when the system call returns 0. Cells are fakes logging their arguments on both sides; the two string conversions it ends with (0x1afc9d, 0x1b0356) are StandIns. Six cell combinations x empty/non-empty result. Mutants killed (filter rz_path_temp_names): buffer size 0x103 for either call, wide test || instead of &&, the zero-length check dropped, ANSI long-name cell ignored, wrong source encoding.

name: TrimToByteLength
notes: Cuts a string to at most N bytes at a character boundary (RZText::CharLength, UTF-8). Every cut length 0..len+2 over ASCII, 2/3/4/6-byte characters, truncated and stray bytes, and a 300-byte text. Mutant killed: fit test >= instead of >.

name: MakeTempFileIn
notes: Makes a new file '<dir><prefix><time><suffix>' by CREATE_NEW opens, counting the time down on each collision, up to 10000 names. The cRZFile members (0x1c0c07, 0x1c285d, 0x1c0faa, 0x1c0e6d) are StandIns over a fake set of taken names, Sprintf (0x1ad6f7) too; the CRT time is patched to a fixed value on the image and the host. Cases: null, empty and non-empty suffix, empty and 300-byte prefix, a prefix cut inside a character, 0..10001 taken names (exhaustion leaves the name alone). File calls (open arguments, close, destruct order) compared as a log. Mutants killed: 9999 attempts, countdown by 2, sharing mode 1, prefix 'RX_', prefix cut 245, suffix '.tm', Close dropped.

name: MakeTempFile
notes: MakeTempFileIn in the system temp directory (relative name when the directory call fails). Same stands as 0x1c23bf plus the temp-path cells and the two conversions; empty and non-empty directory, three suffix forms, 0 and 4 taken names. Mutants killed: the directory call dropped, plus the shared ones of 0x1c23bf (countdown, open mode, suffix).
